$comment: Host capability matrix for awesome-agency. Single source of truth for what Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI each honor. Consumed by .github/scripts/check-host-compat.py and documented in .claude/skills/host-portability/. Observed behavior outranks vendor documentation: where the two disagree, record what was actually seen and say so in `evidence`.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot.note: Reads .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and dereferences symlinks at install time. Verified against ~/.copilot/installed-plugins/ on 2026-08-06, contradicting GitHub's docs.

capabilities.description: Installs plugins from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in a git repo.
capabilities.evidence: ~/.copilot/config.json lists installedPlugins with "marketplace": "awesome-agency"; bundles materialized under ~/.copilot/installed-plugins/awesome-agency/.

capabilities.description: Dereferences pool symlinks into real files at install time.
capabilities.evidence: plugins/steward/scripts is a symlink in-repo but a real directory in the Copilot install cache.

capabilities.description: Loads Agent Skills from SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter.
capabilities.evidence: superpowers and steward skills are available in a Copilot CLI session.

capabilities.description: Loads subagents from markdown files with YAML frontmatter.
capabilities.evidence: steward:* agents are selectable in a Copilot CLI session.

capabilities.description: Honors the `model:` frontmatter field (a pinned full model ID per this repo's convention).

copilot.note: Falls back to the current session model without surfacing an error to the user. Cost and latency degrade; correctness does not.

capabilities.evidence: ~/.copilot/logs: 'model "haiku" is not available; will use current model instead' (also observed for opus and inherit — the same fallback applies to a pinned full ID, which Copilot ignores just as silently).
capabilities.guidance: Keep the pinned full model ID anyway. Both hosts read the same agents/*.md inside a bundle, so per-host values are impossible. Never rely on a cheap model for correctness — an agent must produce correct output at any model. See docs/TODO.md for the deferred Copilot model-selection work.

copilot.note: Logs 'unknown field ignored: color'. Purely cosmetic; no behavioral effect.

capabilities.evidence: ~/.copilot/logs, on every session start, for each project agent declaring color.

capabilities.description: Honors `disable-model-invocation: true`, restricting a skill to explicit invocation.

copilot.note: A skill intended as explicit-invocation-only becomes model-invocable. This is a semantic divergence, not just degradation.

capabilities.evidence: Claude-Code-specific extension; absent from the Agent Skills frontmatter set Copilot reads.
capabilities.guidance: The skill body must still behave sensibly if invoked automatically. Where it must not run unprompted, say so in the first lines of the body so the model self-restricts, rather than relying on the field alone.

copilot.note: Copilot CLI has no slash-command concept; skills fill that role and are invocable as /<skill-name>.

capabilities.evidence: GitHub Copilot CLI docs describe skills as the command equivalent; no commands/ directory is read.
capabilities.guidance: Every shipped command needs a skill counterpart carrying the same capability, or an entry in known_exceptions declaring the bundle Claude-only.

capabilities.description: Runs an MCP server bundled at the plugin root via .mcp.json.

copilot.note: Copilot reads .mcp.json as project-level config, not as a plugin-bundled server, so an installed bundle's server is not started automatically.

capabilities.evidence: GitHub Copilot CLI MCP docs list .mcp.json among project-level config locations.
capabilities.guidance: Document manual setup for Copilot users in the bundle README.

capabilities.description: Supports the hook event names used by the bundle.

copilot.note: Accepts PascalCase event names as a Claude compatibility mode, but supports a smaller event set. See shared_hook_events.

capabilities.evidence: GitHub Copilot CLI hooks reference documents both its native camelCase events and PascalCase compatibility.
capabilities.guidance: Restrict hooks.json to shared_hook_events unless the bundle is declared Claude-only.

capabilities.description: Expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in hook and MCP server commands.

copilot.note: GitHub docs state the variable is not expanded, but the vendored superpowers SessionStart hook uses it and its content does reach a Copilot session. Unresolved.

capabilities.evidence: Contradiction between GitHub docs and observed superpowers behavior; not yet isolated.
capabilities.guidance: Warn only. Failing here would break steward and superpowers immediately. Resolve via the deferred verification task in docs/TODO.md.

known_exceptions.reason: Ships an in-tree MCP server. Copilot users configure it manually; the bundle README documents the steps.
